text:
Maria G: Handing off the night shift — quick FYI about a planned deploy to /inference-service tonight.

Maria G: Window: 02:00 UTC start, freeze 01:30-03:30 UTC. This is a staggered traffic-shift rollout (not a full-cutover) — we'll move 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5–7m waits.

Maria G: Expected risk: small latency bump (~50–150ms P95) during first shard while KV prefix cache warms. Possible transient 429s if upstream throttles spike; circuit-breaker and retry policies are in place.

Maria G: Rollback plan: abort traffic shift and revert to previous replica set (k8s rollout undo), and route traffic back via canary service. Jasper will monitor and can trigger rollback.

Samir Patel: Thanks — who are the rollout watchers and where do we watch metrics? @Jasper @Talia

Jasper: I'm on watcher. Dashboards: /dashboards/inference/latency, /dashboards/inference/errors, and the per-route token-cost chart. Also set a log query: `severity>=WARNING AND service:inference-service` for increases.

Talia Chen: I'll watch quota and upstream 429s. Quick note: if we see 5xx rate >0.5% for two consecutive 1m bins, we pause and investigate. I'll be available for the first two escalation windows.

Oncall Bot: Scheduled deploy job created: deploy/inference-service:staggered-2025-03-18-02_00 (job id: dj-1759112222). Auto-notify on step fail: true.

Leo: Small request — the new quantized model variant is behind a feature flag (ff_infer_quant). Are we enabling it in canary? Maria?

Maria G: Yes — enabling in canary (10% traffic only). Flag scope: canary namespace only. If any quality regression alerts trigger (>2 failed eval prompts in 10m), we toggle off.

Samir Patel: If I need to trigger rollback, what's the exact command? Want to keep it handy.

Jasper: Use:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=prev
curl -X POST $ONCALL_API/route/traffic -d '{"service":"inference-service","pct":100}'
```
I'll paste into Zoom if we go hands-on.

Talia Chen: Adding a quick smoke step after each shift: run `smoke/inference-health-check --sample 50` and check P95 and error rate. If fail, pause.

Maria G: Good — watchers: @Jasper (primary), @Samir Patel (secondary), @Talia Chen (quota/quality). I'll be reachable until 02:20 UTC for any context handoff. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Copy. I'll set pager overrides and keep my phone on. :phone:

Jasper: I'll post live updates in this thread during the rollout; will tag @all if we need a rollback.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: deploy window intersects with maintenance on region-eu network 02:15-02:45 UTC (low probability). If network maintenance impacts route availability, we'll extend waits between steps.

Maria G: Noted — if region-eu network flaps, increase step wait to 12m and reduce next step to +15% instead of +30%.

Leo: One more — post-deploy: please run the end-to-end smoke for top-10 customer IDs to verify no auth regressions.

Maria G: Will do. Thanks everyone — handing off to Jasper and Samir. Leaving a checklist in ops-runbook and will update the deploy ticket with the canary UUID.

Jasper: Acknowledged. Starting watcher readiness checks now. :eyes:

Samir Patel: Oncall handover complete from my side, good luck y'all. :rocket:
